forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account's e-mail: we will send a link there to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 60 minutes and works only once.
forgot.throttled: Too many requests. Try again in 15 minutes.
forgot.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
forgot.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: This password replaces the old one; every open session will be closed.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: This link was already used, has expired or was replaced by a newer one. Ask for a new one.
reset.missingBody: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the e-mail exactly as received, or ask for a new one.
reset.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
reset.network: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
reset.failed: The password could not be saved. Try again.

forced.title: Choose your password
forced.subtitle: Your current password was set by an administrator. Replace it before you continue; you will then sign in again.
forced.wrong: The password you were given is incorrect.
forced.same: Choose a password different from the one you were given.
forced.done: Password changed. Sign in again with the new one.

name.title: My display name
name.hint: This name appears in the header and in the history of your actions.
name.label: Display name

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Everything you were told about, newest first.
notifications.failed: The notifications could not be loaded.

outbox.title: Delivery queue
outbox.subtitle: E-mails and text messages waiting, sent, failing or given up. A failing message is retried automatically; one that was given up can be requeued here.
outbox.expired: This message carried a link that has expired: it cannot be sent again.
